from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(worker_llm=self.llm, moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_AGENT_PROMPT] * 3, moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_DEBATE_MODERATOR_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        finalizer = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_EXTRACT_PROMPT, prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_VERIFY_PROMPT])
        solution = await finalizer(f"{problem}\n\nCandidate output to sanitize and verify:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

CAMPSITE_DEBATE_AGENT_PROMPT = """Solve the campsite puzzle and revise against peer proposals.

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Agent: {agent_id}
Peer proposals:
{all_proposals}

Moderator feedback:
{moderator_input}

Critical focus based on common failures:
- Match every row count exactly.
- Match every column count exactly.
- No two tents may touch, including diagonally.
- Tents must be on original empty cells only.
- Trees must remain X.
- Every tree must have at least one horizontally/vertically adjacent tent.
- Re-check the whole board after each local fix because one correction can break counts or create tent contact.
- Do not trust a proposal just because counts match; also verify adjacency and no-touch constraints.
- Prefer a complete valid board over partial reasoning.

Return only the final board in this exact format:
<begin_board>
[final board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>
"""

CAMPSITE_DEBATE_MODERATOR_PROMPT = """You are moderating a campsite-solving debate.

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Is final: {is_final}

Current proposals:
{all_proposals}

Your job:
- Identify the most likely rule violations in the proposals.
- Emphasize exact row/column counts and no diagonal tent contact.
- Push agents to correct tree-to-tent adjacency mistakes.
- Reject any proposal that includes explanation mixed with the board.
- In the final round, choose the best candidate board, not the best explanation.

If is_final is false, return short corrective guidance only.
If is_final is true, return only:
<begin_board>
[final board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>
"""

CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_EXTRACT_PROMPT = """You will receive a campsite puzzle plus noisy candidate output that may contain explanations.

Input:
{problem}

Task:
- Extract exactly one candidate board if present.
- Ignore all explanations.
- If multiple boards appear, keep the single most plausible one based on the puzzle constraints.
- Output only one board and nothing else.

Required format:
<begin_board>
[final board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>
"""

CAMPSITE_FINALIZER_VERIFY_PROMPT = """You are doing a final strict verification pass for a campsite puzzle.

Input:
{previous_output}

Rules to verify:
- Trees X must stay unchanged.
- Tents * must appear only on original empty cells.
- Total tents must match the stated total.
- Every row count must match exactly.
- Every column count must match exactly.
- No two tents may touch horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
- Every tree must have at least one horizontally/vertically adjacent tent.

If the board violates any rule, minimally repair it and re-check all rules again.
Return only the final verified board in this exact format:
<begin_board>
[final board with space-separated cells]
<end_board>
"""
